entities.summary: Băile Govora is a Romanian spa town in Vâlcea County, about 20 km (12 mi) south-west of Râmnicu Vâlcea and west of the Olt River, in the historical region of Oltenia. Notable features of the town include the Govora Abbey and the nearby Dintr-un lemn Monastery.
